parameters.command: =node /home/node/scripts/nostr_notifier.js job-alert '{{ JSON.stringify({ job: { job_title: $json.job.job_title, company: $json.job.company, application_method: ($json.job.has_easy_apply ? 'easy_apply' : 'email'), ai_priority_tier: $json.job.ai_priority_tier, ai_job_match_score: $json.job.ai_job_match_score, job_url: $json.job.job_url }, research: ($json.research_status === 'ok' ? $json.research : null) }).replace(/'/g, "'\\''") }}'
